incidents.name: AIRWA public setBurnRate()
incidents.notes: AIRWA.setBurnRate(uint256) has no owner check, so the attacker set the burn rate to 98%, triggered it with a zero-value transfer to the LP to destroy the pair's AIRWA, reset it and sold into the inflated price.

sources.ref: onchain review: victim 0x3af7da38c9f68df9549ce1980eef4ac6b635223a created 2025-04-03T16:12:26Z by 0xe16f74bf9bb4b8670bc4d39b8cc4abfae3b2a421, which is not the attack-tx sender 0x70f0406e0a50c53304194b2668ec853d664a3d9c; 0 EIP-1967 Upgraded events on the victim before the incident; code age measured from deployment (onchain). 56.73 BNB x $591.44/BNB at the incident timestamp 1743733985 (DefiLlama coingecko:binancecoin) = $33,552.
